coverage: Trial admission and pool publication rows open rationale, evidence refs and consultation decision ID.
Authenticated operator sees actions; viewer with local admin display role sees no actions and a readable permission note; absent command roles fail closed.
Writes disabled visibly disables both actions without calling the command.
Approve and reject require a memo and call the existing facade with the source id and exact memo.
Actual returned receipt, typed BffError envelope (HTTP status, message, code, details, correlation id), and HTTP-success refusal envelope remain visible.
Receipt remains open when refresh removes the decided row from the pending queue.
Approved, rejected, superseded and canceled rows have no decision actions.
Keyboard entry/close, exact deep link and encoded OODA journal navigation.
